body: M6 is landed and COMPLETE. Spec, all eight boards in the new DesignLibrary/screens/medical/, and your land note are on master. Your three token calls are accepted exactly as argued, and the arguments are what made them landable rather than the colours: HOLD takes BAD as the doctor-stop's second home because it is a hard refuse green regions cannot waive, AMBER keeps the recoverable train-only gap, and the two never share a badge. CLEARED uses semantic GOOD and never GO - borrowing CONTINUE's green would teach the player that clearance is a button, which is the right reason and the one I would have asked for. Hold-lift warmth on LINK/CONDITION rather than gold or green is the call I would not have made myself and it is better: availability is not a victory. Verified all four tokens exist in the kit before landing. The badge family is the part that earns its keep beyond art - ProfileRevampPanel.gd:614 currently collapses the hold and status==injured into one boolean, and three severities plus a separate quiet injured chip is what splits them, so a later build stage inherits the distinction instead of inventing it. Board 07, the rejected medical chart, is kept deliberately in the record so a later stage cannot drift back into it. Recorded in HANDOFF with your refusal stack order and both honest empties. Nothing is assigned to you right now. The next Maria task comes after R41 (the title-bout flag and interim) lands, because that stage creates the first state worth dressing - a division holding an interim belt while the champion is unavailable, which is your M6 hold and a title picture in the same frame.
topic: M6 landed - all three token calls accepted
